# Other TV

Every app in this list that runs on Other TV. That is 15 apps with 8 for Plex and 4 for Jellyfin and 3 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Video and general

- [Dooplex](https://github.com/jackra1n/Dooplex) - Client for Zidoo players that hands playback to the native player. `Plex` · `Android TV` `Other TV` · `GPL-3.0`
- [Emby for Samsung Smart TV Series D](https://github.com/michael-lurquin/Emby-Samsung-SmartTV-Series-D) - Samsung Smart TV Series D app, last updated in 2017. `Emby` · `Other TV` · `Open source` `Free` `Stale 2017`
- [emplexer](https://github.com/newloran2/emplexer) - Plex client for Dune HD media players. `Plex` · `Other TV` · `Open source` `Stale 2015`
- [FinLightning](https://github.com/hjourdain-ryvr/finlightning) - TV app built on the Lightning 3 / Blits UI framework. `Jellyfin` · `Tizen` `Other TV` · `Apache-2.0` `Free`
- [jellyfin-saphiOS](https://github.com/edvdourado/jellyfin-saphiOS) - Framework-free web app aimed at Philips SAPHI / NetTV smart TVs. `Jellyfin` · `Other TV` · `Open source` `Free` `Beta`
- [Neolume](https://github.com/itsab1989/neolume) - Client for 2014 Samsung Orsay TVs. `Plex` · `Other TV` · `Open source`
- [Oriel](https://github.com/GR3ee3N/Oriel) - Plex client for CoreELEC on Amlogic boxes. `Plex` · `Other TV` · `GPL-3.0`
- [p2F](https://forums.plex.tv/t/p2f-is-still-alive-p2f-est-toujours-vivant/937932) - Plex client for the Freebox Revolution set-top box. `Plex` · `Other TV` · `Stale 2022`
- [panasonic-viera-jellyfin](https://github.com/n4zgu1/panasonic-viera-jellyfin) - ES5 web app plus a LAN proxy for Panasonic Viera Connect TVs. `Jellyfin` · `Other TV` · `Open source` `Free`
- [PLAYz](https://github.com/simonjhogan/playz-emby) - HTML5 client for smart TVs; last updated in 2019. `Emby` · `Web` `Other TV` · `Apache-2.0` `Free` `Stale 2019`
- [plex.lg](https://github.com/cubedro/plex.lg) - Plex client for 2013 LG Smart TVs. `Plex` · `Other TV` · `Apache-2.0` `Stale 2013`
- [plex-lgtv-netcast](https://github.com/razor2611/plex-lgtv-netcast) - Plex interface for older LG NetCast smart TVs. `Plex` · `Other TV` · `Open source` `Stale 2014`
- [PlexToZidoo](https://github.com/hpn789/PlexToZidoo) - Plays Plex items in the native player of Zidoo media players. `Plex` · `Other TV` · `Open source` `Stale 2023`
- [Redefin](https://github.com/laborantine/ReDeFin) - Freebox set-top box app that also targets Devialet devices. `Jellyfin` · `Other TV` · `GPL-3.0` `Free`
- [zmby](https://github.com/zhenyuefu/zmby) - Multi-server Emby client for Android TV and Zidoo players. `Emby` · `Android TV` `Other TV` · `GPL-3.0`
